content.en: The **Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme** aims to boost domestic manufacturing by offering financial rewards to companies for achieving specific production and sales targets. By linking incentives directly to **incremental production**, the government encourages firms to scale up operations, invest in technology, and enhance **global competitiveness**.

rows.en: To make domestic manufacturing globally competitive

definition.en: Incentives are disbursed only after the company meets predefined production and investment milestones.
definition.hi: Incentives are disbursed only after the company meets predefined production and investment milestones.

content.en: Reducing reliance on foreign goods by incentivizing local production of critical components.
content.hi: Reducing reliance on foreign goods by incentivizing local production of critical components.

content.en: Do not confuse PLI with direct subsidies; PLI is strictly output-linked, not input-linked.

content.en: Focus on how PLI aligns with the goal of becoming a $5 trillion economy.

keyTakeaways.en: PLI promotes scale and efficiency in manufacturing.
